body:
## What's Changed
* doc: Add client ID note by @hrkfdn in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1880
* chore(toolchain): update by @hrkfdn in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1881
* chore(deps): bump notify-rust from 4.18.0 to 4.18.1 in the cargo group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1879
* chore(deps): bump the cargo group across 1 directory with 7 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1892
* chore(toolchain): update by @hrkfdn in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1893
* fix: blank screen for 20+ seconds at startup when rate limited by @aw-snap in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1886
* fix: keep playing when the Spotify connection drops by @aw-snap in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1888
* chore(deps): bump rustls from 0.23.43 to 0.23.45 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1883
* fix: use the saved credentials when restarting the session by @aw-snap in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1889
* perf: reduce constant rate limits by not refetching all liked songs every start by @aw-snap in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1887
* chore(deps): bump the cargo group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1895
* fix: handle playlists that fail to load by @aw-snap in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1884
* chore(ci): Update macOS runner to `latest` by @hrkfdn in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1899
* chore(deps): bump rustls from 0.23.45 to 0.23.46 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1900
* fix(windows): build with crossterm so wide characters render correctly by @luisdavidtrejosrojas in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1898
* chore(deps): bump the cargo group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1901
* chore: Release 1.5.1 by @hrkfdn in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1903

## New Contributors
* @luisdavidtrejosrojas made their first contribution in https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/pull/1898

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hrkfdn/ncspot/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1
